s: Gets line items for a specific inter-project transfer.

s: Adds a line item to an inter-project transfer.
d: Adds a new line item to an existing inter-project transfer in Draft state.

s: Adds comments to an inter-project transfer.
d: Adds up to 100 comments to the specified inter-project transfer document.

s: Get details of attachments for an inter-project transfer
d: Returns the list of attachments associated with the specified inter-project transfer document.

s: Adds attachments to an inter-project transfer.
d: Uploads one or more attachments to the specified inter-project transfer document.

s: Updates an attachment for an inter-project transfer.
d: Updates the metadata of an existing attachment on the specified inter-project transfer document.

s: Deletes attachments from an inter-project transfer.
d: Removes one or more attachments from the specified inter-project transfer document by file IDs.

s: Gets a paginated list of inter-project transfer line items.
d: Returns a paginated list of inter-project transfer line items across all transfer documents. Supports multiple view types: Normal (default), Short, Compact, and Id.

s: Gets configurable columns for inter-project transfers.
d: Returns the list of configurable columns available for the inter-project transfer summary or line items view. These columns can be used to customize which fields are displayed in the UI.

s: Gets properties for inter-project transfers.
d: Returns the list of custom properties defined for inter-project transfers. Supports Normal (default) and Keys view types.

s: Get details of an attachment for an inter-project transfer
d: Returns the details of a specific attachment identified by its file ID on the specified inter-project transfer document.

s: Gets the change history for a specific inter-project transfer.
d: Returns a paginated list of audit history entries for the specified inter-project transfer document, showing field-level changes made over time.

s: Get all properties for a resource
Bulk transition defects to a new status.
d: Transitions multiple defect documents to the specified status in a single operation. All specified defect IDs must belong to the same project.

s: Updates a line item for a defect.
d: Updates resolution_status, notes, and location_id for defect line items. When the resolution is ADD_TO_STOCK, a location_id must be provided; otherwise a 400 (RESOLUTION_LOCATION_NOT_SET) is returned. When resolving a defect line with ADD_TO_STOCK resolution for a PO that origin…

s: Updates multiple line items for a defect.
d: When resolving a defect line with ADD_TO_STOCK resolution for a PO that originates from a commitment, an invoice (requisition) will be created in Procore for the defect quantity.

s: Un-resolves resolved line items for a defect.
d: Reverses the resolution of one or more resolved defect line items, placing the material back into the defect condition at the specified location and updating the resolution notes. A location_id is required unless the defect line condition is Short, in which case no destination l…

s: Get details of one or more attachments for a defect resource.
d: Returns the details of all attachments associated with a specific defect.

s: Adds attachments to a defect resource.
d: Either provide a file_id already obtained from the File Access Service (FAS), or omit it to have FAS create a new file record. The response includes the file_id and, when FAS creates the record, an upload URL the client uses to upload the file content.

s: Updates attachment for a defect resource.
d: Updates the metadata of an existing attachment on a defect resource, such as its description or name.

s: Deletes attachments from a defect resource.
d: Removes one or more attachments from the defect by their file IDs. The attachment records are removed from the database. The system attempts to delete the underlying files from storage; storage deletion failures are not surfaced to the caller.

s: Adds comments to a defect resource.
d: Adds one or more comments to a defect document. A maximum of 100 comments can be added in a single request.

s: Get Defect Header by ID
d: Returns the header details for a specific defect document.

s: Updates a defect resource.
d: Updates header fields on a defect document such as title, notes, and status. Use status transitions to move the defect through its workflow states.

s: Get all Defects
d: Returns a paginated list of defects for the project.

s: Get all Defect Line Items
d: Returns a paginated list of defect line items across all defects.

s: Get Defect Line Items by Defect ID
d: Returns the line items for a specific defect document, including quantities, material details, and associated location information.

s: Get Defect by ID
d: Returns the full details of a specific defect, including all header fields and associated line item information.

s: Get all configurable columns for Defects
d: Returns the list of configurable columns available for defect records.

s: Get all properties for Defects
d: Returns the list of custom property definitions available for defects.

s: Get details of a single attachment for a defect resource.
d: Returns the details of a single attachment on a defect.

s: Gets change history for a defect.
d: Returns the change history for a specific defect, including what was changed, when, and by whom.

s: Gets related documents for a defect.
d: Returns a list of documents related to a specific defect, such as needs, purchase orders, shipments, and receipts.

s: Get all properties for a resource
Gets a paginated list of adjustment documents.
d: Returns a paginated list of adjustment documents with filtering and sorting options. Supports multiple view types: Normal (default), Short, Compact, Extended, and Id.

s: Creates a new adjustment document.
d: The adjustment document is created in Draft status. Line items can be added after creation or included in the initial request.

s: Updates a line item on an adjustment document.
d: Updates specific fields of an adjustment line item. - Adjustment type determines the operation: Add to Stock or Remove from Stock. - Storage location and item condition can be updated independently; both must be set before the adjustment can be posted to Final. - Quantity must b…

s: Deletes an adjustment line item from an adjustment document.
d: The adjustment document must not be in a Final state for line items to be removed.

s: Gets line items for a specific adjustment document.
d: Returns a paginated list of line items for the specified adjustment document. Each line item includes item details, adjustment type, quantity, location, and condition.

s: Adds new line items to an existing adjustment document.
d: Each line item requires an item ID, adjustment type (Add to Stock or Remove from Stock), and quantity greater than zero. Storage location and item condition are optional at create time but both are required before the adjustment can be posted to Final.

s: Gets the header details for a specific adjustment document.
d: Returns the header information for an adjustment document including status, dates, title, notes, and properties. Supports Normal (default) and Extended view types.

s: Updates an adjustment document header.
d: Updates header fields such as title, notes, and status on the adjustment document. Use status transitions to move the adjustment through its workflow states.

s: Recycles an adjustment document.
d: This performs a soft delete (recycle) of the adjustment document. Recycled documents can be restored from the recycle bin by an admin user.

s: Add up to 100 comments to an adjustment
d: Adds one or more comments to an adjustment document. A maximum of 100 comments can be added in a single request.

s: Get details of attachments for an adjustment
d: Returns metadata for all attachments associated with the specified adjustment document, including file name, MIME type, and download URL.

s: Adds one or more attachments to an adjustment document.
d: Either provide a file_id already obtained from the File Access Service (FAS), or omit it to have FAS create a new file record. The response includes the file_id and, when FAS creates the record, an upload URL the client uses to upload the file content.

s: Updates an attachment for an adjustment resource.
d: Updates the metadata of an existing attachment on an adjustment resource, such as its description or name.

s: Deletes attachment(s) from an adjustment resource.
d: Removes one or more attachments from the adjustment by their file IDs. The attachment records are removed from the database. The system attempts to delete the underlying files from storage; storage deletion failures are not surfaced to the caller.

s: Gets a paginated list of adjustment line items.
d: Returns a paginated list of adjustment line items across all adjustment documents. Supports multiple view types: Normal (default), Short, Compact, Extended, and Id.

s: Get all configurable columns for adjustments.
d: Returns the list of configurable columns available for the adjustment summary or line items view. These columns can be used to customize which fields are displayed in the UI.

s: Get all properties for adjustments
d: Returns the list of custom/dynamic properties defined for adjustment documents. Properties are used to capture additional data fields beyond the standard adjustment fields.

s: Get details of an attachment for an adjustment
d: Returns metadata for the specified attachment file, including file name, MIME type, and download URL.

s: Get change history for an adjustment.
d: Returns a paginated list of change history events for the specified adjustment document. Each entry describes what changed, when it changed, and who made the change.
